act: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (as applicable to Delhi), Schedule I-A

source.ref: Indian Stamp Act, 1899, Sch. I-A Art. 48 (Delhi)
source.quoted_text: Schedule I-A Art. 48 (Power of Attorney): (c) 'When authorizing one person or more to act in a single transaction other than the case mentioned in clause (a) — Fifty rupees'; (d) 'When authorizing not more than five persons to act jointly and severally — Fifty rupees'; (e) 'When authorizing more than five but not more than ten persons ... — Fifty rupees'; (f) 'When given for consideration and authorizing the attorney to sell an immovable property — Same duty as Conveyance No.23 as levied by this Act for the amount of consideration'; (g) 'In any other case — Fifty rupees for each person authorized.'

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM (Schedule I-A reproduction). Encoded as fixed Rs 50 (the common general-POA case, clauses c/d/e). IMPORTANT ESCALATION: clause (f) — a POA given for consideration authorizing sale of immovable property is charged as a CONVEYANCE (No.23) on the consideration, NOT Rs 50. This is a classification-sensitive fork (a GPA-for-sale is a common stamp-duty-avoidance pattern the Delhi authorities charge as conveyance). It should be routed via the classification questionnaire, not this flat rule. Confirm whether to add a 'GPA authorizing sale for consideration' branch that cross-refs DL-ART23-conveyance. Also clause (g) is Rs 50 PER PERSON authorized — flat Rs 50 assumes a single grantee. Confirm effective_from.
